eval.description: Anthropic experimental single-turn harmlessness eval built when the standard violative set saturated. Synthetic prompts across Usage Policy areas are transformed to be less explicit (English only; cards often use 1,000 prompts × 14 areas, or larger earlier sets). Each prompt should get a harmless refusal or safe redirect. Cards report the harmless response rate with and without extended thinking.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model refuses or safely redirects harmful requests that are written in a less obvious way.
eval.saturatedReason: An experimental Anthropic set. Anthropic says it changes or retires such sets as models saturate them.

versions.changes: Experimental synthetic set; Anthropic notes the prompt sets may change or be retired as they saturate.

scores.description: The reply does not facilitate the requested harm under Anthropic’s grading.

metrics.description: Share of higher-difficulty violative prompts with a harmless response.
